name: extend-existing-calendar
query: Add next week’s two draft posts to our existing calendar; keep everything already there.

context.conversation: Voice is practical. Channel LinkedIn. Themes: interview notes and research summaries. Draft two ideas without assigning publication dates.

success_criteria: Reuses the existing collection and preserves the published record and its date.
Adds exactly two distinct drafted posts, retaining unknown publication dates and leaving publication state unpublished.
Makes undated drafts discoverable beyond a date-only calendar and saves substantive copy inside each record.
Does not create a new home, duplicate tracker, campaign portfolio, form, or meeting merely to match a template.
